name: LacusTstopandBE
summary: This EA is a trailing stop and break-even utility that manages existing open positions by moving stop losses to breakeven or trailing them as price moves in favor. It does not open trades on its own but instead applies dynamic trailing stop and break-even logic to manually or otherwise opened positions.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个追踪止损和保本工具，通过在价格有利方向移动时将止损移至保本位或动态追踪止损来管理已有的持仓。它不会自行开仓，而是对手动或其他方式开立的仓位应用动态追踪止损和保本逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是作为仓位管理辅助工具，不自行产生交易信号或开仓。入场条件不适用，因为它不执行开仓操作，仅在已有持仓的基础上运作。出场条件通过追踪止损和保本机制实现：当价格朝有利方向移动达到设定点数时，将止损移至保本位；当利润继续增长时，止损会以设定的步长持续追踪价格。仓位管理方面，EA不对仓位大小进行控制，仅管理已有仓位的止损水平。资金管理方面，EA不涉及资金管理逻辑，仅提供风险保护功能，通过追踪止损锁定利润并限制回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA functions as a position management utility and does not generate its own trade signals or open positions. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not execute opening trades; it operates solely on existing positions. Exit conditions are implemented through trailing stop and break-even mechanisms: when price moves favorably by a configured number of points, the stop loss is moved to breakeven; as profit continues to grow, the stop loss trails price at a configured step distance. Position sizing is not managed by this EA, as it only adjusts stop loss levels on already-opened positions. Money management is not within the scope of this EA, which focuses purely on risk protection by locking in profits and limiting drawdown through trailing stops.

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description_en: Minimum step to adjust take-profit in points

parameters.name: BreakEvenProfit
parameters.description: 保本后锁定的利润点数

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 仓位魔术编号，0表示管理所有仓位
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to manage; 0 manages all orders

pros: 自动化管理止损，减少手动操作负担
保本功能有效锁定利润，防止盈利仓位转为亏损
追踪止损逻辑灵活，可配置步长和距离参数
pros_en: Automated stop loss management reduces manual oversight burden
Break-even feature effectively locks in profits and prevents winning trades from turning into losers
Flexible trailing stop logic with configurable step and distance parameters
cons: 不进行开仓操作，需配合其他信号源使用
在剧烈波动行情中追踪止损可能被过早触发导致仓位提前平出
缺少对点差和滑点的过滤处理，可能在高点差环境下表现不佳
cons_en: Does not open positions on its own and must be paired with another signal source
Trailing stops may be triggered prematurely during volatile market conditions, causing early position exits
Lacks spread and slippage filtering, which may lead to suboptimal performance in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加对点差和滑点的过滤机制，避免高点差时段触发追踪止损
加入仓位筛选功能，支持按品种、方向或盈利金额选择性管理
improvements_en: Add spread and slippage filtering to avoid triggering trailing stops during high-spread periods
Add position filtering to support selective management by symbol, direction, or profit amount

risk_points: 作为纯工具类EA不产生交易风险，但错误参数设置可能导致止损过紧或过松
不检查新K线可能导致同一根K线内多次修改止损增加服务器负担
risk_points_en: As a pure utility EA it does not generate trading risk, but incorrect parameter settings may result in stops being too tight or too loose
Lack of new bar checking may cause multiple stop loss modifications within the same bar, increasing server load

It does not open trades on its own but instead applies dynamic trailing stop and break-even logic to manually or otherwise opened positions.
